faq.q: Does this band cover attached homes too?
faq.a: The page frames itself as a detached band — its title is "Tsawwassen Homes Under $1.8M | Detached MLS® Listings" and its heading is "Buying a Detached Home Under $1.8M in Tsawwassen, BC", and the listings it shows are detached houses.

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer get an exemption inside this band?
faq.a: At the band's lower end, yes: the first time home buyers' program full exemption caps at a fair market value of $835,000 and the newly built home exemption's full threshold is $1,100,000 (eliminated at $1,150,000) — both inside this band's range, unlike the over-$1.8M band where neither reaches.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
